correctness.rationale: The published star/top classification covers every clique. Pairwise Ferrers intersection or union uniquely identifies each lower-star or upper-top source. For r>=3 a clique cannot have both: r distinct one-cell extensions of the same (n-1)-cell diagram have n-1+r>n+1 cells in their union. Edges, which have both, are counted only by lower-star incidence. Thus c_2(n)=sum_{mu|-n-1} binom(d(mu)+1,2) and c_r(n)=sum_{mu|-n-1} binom(d(mu)+1,r)+sum_{nu|-n+1} binom(d(nu),r), r>=3. The formal factorization F(q,1+x)=P(q)prod_j(1+xq^j) and Euler distinct-part identity give the displayed rational products. The unique minimum exponent corresponds to one staircase lower partition and its r distinct covers. Independent direct clique enumeration 1..16 and integer corner enumerations agree, as do published face counts up to size five in listed higher cases. Infinite assertions rest on mathematical proof, not finite tests.
